PMID:30283141 Isolating viable single cells from both pancreas and liver of the same mouse was not possible, therefore, 2 males and 2 females were used for each. Following single cell dissociation as described below, cell suspensions were either used for FACS of individual cells into 384-well plates, or for microfluidic droplet library preparation./https://figshare.com/articles/Single-cell_RNA-seq_data_from_microfluidic_emulsion/5715025 for sex information
